stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a ringed space.
The category of sheaves of $\mathcal{O}_X$-modules on $X$
has enough injectives. In fact it has functorial injective embeddings.
conclusions:
The category of sheaves of $\mathcal{O}_X$-modules on $X$
has enough injectives. In fact it has functorial injective embeddings.

reason: Use injective embeddings of local O_X-stalk modules, build a sheaf of products of skyscrapers, and apply the stalk adjunction plus product-of-injectives theorem to obtain a functorial injective embedding.
